title: The Lost Monsoon
author: Ansel Ishikawa
blurb: August Nystrom, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
